integrity: General proof is symbolic; four finite-field checks are corroboration, not a proof for all fields. Pálfy print month June 1998 is known but no exact print day is asserted; first verified exact-date online source is 2009-01-20.
scientific_limitations: Only finite characteristic-two fields, quotient modulo t^6, and ordinary conjugacy. The prime-field specialization was established earlier by Pálfy. Priority for extension fields remains subject to full-text comparison with Hegedus and other possible equivalent works; independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Trace-split conjugacy classes in the fourth finite Nottingham quotient over even fields
